## Summary

Discharges the context/memory producer residual (BL-15): the Round-1 §5c
machinery emitted `context.*` rows only from unit call sites — now the
driver sequences the producer legs on a real run, `resume_set` consumers
read on resume, the `judged`/`human` artefact detectors have real call
sites, and the packaged `hh-compact-evict-oldest` variant carries a
byte-differential conformance corpus against the kernel rung over
`benchset.stage3.v1`.

1. **Driver-owned producer seams** — `MemoryPort` (retrieve /
   `trigger_retrieve` / `resume_set_read` / `mark_scope_ended` /
   `procedure_capabilities`), `CompactionDone.emitted`,
   `AssembledRequest.pre_events`, `GateOutcome.emitted`,
   `DriverConfig.resume_set_heads`. Ports return `(class, payload)` rows
   in emit order; the driver appends under the writer lease (CC3 —
   durable-before-visible, one appender). A `resume_set`-armed run drains
   its heads before the first `decide`; armed-without-port is a typed
   `UnbackedPort{kind:"resume_set"}`, never silently skipped.
2. **`hh-embed` wiring** — one shared `Rc<RefCell<KernelContext>>` feeds
   `KernelAssembler`, `KernelMemory`, `KernelCompaction` (CC1: the store
   the assembler selects over is the store the reader reads);
   `supplies.procedures` ingestion mints durable `context.memory.written`
   rows; the resume fold rehydrates skeletons from the durable prefix
   (identity never re-minted; `unknown` lifecycle honestly labelled).
3. **Effect-path legality repair** — the first real drive surfaced an
   illegal lifecycle: `intended` host effects awaiting the host were
   minted `unknown{awaiting_host}` and tripped INV-2. The path now mints
   `action.effect.intended{effective_risk_class}` →
   `security.permission.decided` → `action.effect.authorized` →
   `prepared` → `committed{fencing_token}` → terminal only on actual
   settlement; an all-pending batch parks `wait` honestly; quarantine
   rows land before `lifecycle.turn.finished`;
   `security.audit.checkpoint`'s `invariant_id`/`evidence_refs` members
   are declared audit fields (schema change in the class table, CC7-side).
4. **Detectors (member e)** — `verify{subject: artefact_activation |
   artefact_followed}` mints `detector: judged` rows carrying the
   verdict's `confidence_ppm`/`evidence_ref` (never `1_000_000`; judged
   evidence never launders into a deterministic `followed`);
   `Cue::HumanInput::ArtefactMark` mints the `human` activation.
5. **OOP differential corpus (member f)** — `hh-compact-evict-oldest` is
   now a thin binary over `src/lib.rs`'s `compact` module, so
   `tests/r2_5_differential.rs` runs the *same* code the packaged variant
   serves. Over `benchset.stage3.v1` (each task's recorded `model_io`
   projected to the contract `context_view`, 4-bytes/token estimator):
   **23/23 members produce byte-identical evicted-seq verdicts** vs the
   kernel `evict_oldest` rung; the `occupancy − cap ∈ [0,8)` band is a
   typed `n/a{omission_placeholder_band}` — the kernel reserves a
   `kernel_omission` placeholder the wire contract doesn't model (never
   silently shaped, ADR-0336 D3).
6. **DF-S1.19-2 corpus legs** (`hh-bench/tests/r2_5_corpus.rs`, 5 tests ×
   23 members): labelled corpora (authority floor partitions the corpus:
   23 served at `unverified`, 23 withheld at `principal`), `resume_set`
   runs (23 heads resolve `by_name` `Live` through the same scope-walk
   the port uses), `environment_epoch` providers (23 members expire
   `dependency_changed` on republish), judged-conflict fixtures (23
   `ConflictSet`s `detector:"deterministic"`; the `judged` member emits
   `n/a{judged_conflict_detector_staged_c2}` — staged C2).

## Decisions

ADR-0336: D1 driver-owned sequencing with row-returning ports; D2
pending host effects stay open + `wait` (never `unknown{awaiting_host}`);
D3 the differential corpus's declared shared subdomain + typed-`n/a`
band; D4 judged/human corpus legs as typed `n/a` (no recorded judge
verdicts/human marks in `benchset.stage3.v1` — legs exercised at driver
level); D5 corpus legs over the real `MemoryStore`; D6 the size
deviation owned (see Size).
